title: Navigation has no URL or browser-history state
evidence: src/store.tsx:80,94: route is React state initialized to customers; navigate only calls setRoute. The preview URL stayed / while moving through customer, editor and assignment screens.
impact: Refresh loses location; browser Back, bookmarks and shared links cannot restore a customer, tab or workflow.
fix: Represent customer, tab, template and review routes in the URL; preserve appropriate list context on return.
test: Open a customer history link in a new tab, refresh it, and use browser Back/Forward across tabs and workflows.

title: Unsaved work can be discarded without warning
evidence: src/pages/flows/TemplateWizard.tsx:27,41; src/components/Shell.tsx:62,308: drafts are component state and Cancel, Customers, home and Logout do not check dirty state.
impact: An agent can lose a carefully formatted signature or recipient selection through ordinary navigation.
fix: Track dirty state, offer keep editing/discard/save, and preserve drafts across accidental reload when appropriate.
test: Edit an existing template, then try Cancel, sidebar home, Logout and refresh; verify recovery and explicit discard.

title: Screen changes do not move focus or announce the destination
evidence: src/store.tsx:94: navigation updates route and scroll only; no route-heading focus management is implemented.
impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users can lose context when the invoking control unmounts.
fix: Focus the destination heading or main region on full-page navigation, while retaining the existing tab keyboard model.
test: Navigate customer → editor → assignment using only keyboard and verify the announced page and logical next Tab target.

title: Persistence failures have no recovery state
evidence: src/store.tsx:65–85: JSON reads are caught but schema is not validated; localStorage.setItem is unguarded. Agent identity and all demo records share one persisted object.
impact: A storage quota, blocked storage or valid JSON with an incompatible schema can break persistence or rendering without a useful explanation.
fix: Validate and version persisted data, catch writes, and show a recoverable local-save failure with an export/reset option.
test: Exercise blocked storage, quota exhaustion and an old/incompatible payload without losing recoverable user work.

title: Error toasts expire as quickly as success messages
evidence: src/store.tsx:88–92 and src/components/Shell.tsx:318: every tone expires after 3.6 seconds; toasts are pointer-events-none and have no dismiss action.
impact: A user may miss an error or be unable to keep it visible while correcting the problem.
fix: Keep actionable failures inline or persistent; allow dismissal and pause transient notifications on focus/hover.
test: Trigger an error and verify it remains available long enough to understand and recover.

title: Sign-in validation is generic and unannounced
evidence: src/pages/Login.tsx:23–34,83,116: noValidate bypasses native email validation; the error paragraph lacks role=alert, aria-describedby and input-specific aria-invalid.
impact: Malformed email goes through a simulated sign-in delay, and assistive technology may not announce the failure.
fix: Validate email before submit; associate errors with the relevant fields and announce authentication failures without revealing which credential was wrong.
test: Submit empty, malformed-email and incorrect-credential cases with keyboard and a screen reader.

title: Sign-in lacks an access-recovery path
evidence: src/pages/Login.tsx: sign in and demo-fill are the only entry actions; no recovery or contact-admin route is shown.
impact: An agent who cannot sign in has no next step.
fix: Add a contact-admin or approved password-recovery path once the authentication ownership model is confirmed.
test: A first-time agent who lacks credentials can identify the correct support path without leaving the product to guess.

title: Large customer lists have no sorting or direct page access
evidence: src/pages/Customers.tsx: table headers are static; src/components/TablePagination.tsx: only previous/next. The preview contains 1,312 customers and 219 pages at its current Auto size.
impact: Agents cannot quickly prioritize attention-needed customers by recent activity or jump through a large directory.
fix: Add useful sorting, especially name/status/activity, and consider direct page access or a stronger quick-jump search.
test: Find the most recently active attention-needed customer and a customer near the end of a large list.

title: Filter application differs between screens
evidence: src/pages/Customers.tsx: draft filters require Search; src/components/UserTable.tsx: filters apply immediately.
impact: A status dropdown can appear changed while the customer results still reflect the previous filter.
fix: Use a consistent application model, or label the action Apply filters and indicate pending changes clearly.
test: Change only the customer status filter and verify that the displayed state and results cannot be mistaken for one another.

title: Auto pagination measures only the first row
evidence: src/pages/Customers.tsx:43–55 uses the first tbody row height to calculate capacity. At the first desktop inspection the footer said 1–9 while lower rows needed internal scrolling because long names/domains increased row heights.
impact: Auto does not reliably fit the visible rows and changes page boundaries with viewport size.
fix: Use a stable row-density rule, measure cumulative actual row heights, or replace Auto with predictable page sizes.
test: Mix short and very long values at 1280px, 1024px and compact heights; verify the Auto promise and stable navigation.

title: Zero and unavailable metrics share the same dash
evidence: src/pages/Customers.tsx: users || '—' and delegates || '—' render both zero values and unavailable values identically.
impact: Agents cannot distinguish no delegates from unknown delegate data.
fix: Use 0 for known zero, and an explicit unavailable/not loaded treatment for missing data; define the signature-coverage denominator.
test: Compare a ready customer with no delegates to a pending customer without directory data.

title: Pending/error customer setup has no completion or repair path
evidence: src/components/AddCustomerDialog.tsx:124 saves Setup pending; src/store.tsx:117 fixes the new status to pending; src/pages/CustomerDetail.tsx offers no verify, reconnect, replace-key or retry action. Atlas Studio showed Not configured and Directory unavailable with no repair CTA.
impact: The onboarding process reaches a dead end; later assignment checks tell users to set up a directory they cannot configure here.
fix: Design a setup status panel with explicit local-demo limitations and a concrete verify/retry/reconfigure path for the intended connected implementation.
test: Trace add customer → pending → verified ready and invalid permission → repair → retry, preserving entered metadata.

title: The demo requires a real-form private-key file for a local placeholder
evidence: src/components/AddCustomerDialog.tsx:17–59 validates an RSA private key, returns only the account email and discards the key. The local-only explanation is below the form and initially below the modal fold.
impact: Users may provide a real credential to a demonstration that cannot connect or complete setup.
fix: Offer a clearly labeled sample/demo onboarding path and put the local-only handling explanation before the upload. Define secure credential handling separately for any connected version.
test: A new user can understand what is read, retained and connected before selecting any file; demo onboarding works without a real key.

title: Setup instructions are hard to copy and verify
evidence: src/components/AddCustomerDialog.tsx:158–182: scopes appear in a single-line input; setup asks for client ID but readServiceAccountEmail only returns email.
impact: An agent must inspect the original file and manually copy a long truncated string to follow the instructions.
fix: Provide Copy scopes with feedback and show the parsed non-secret client ID/account identity for confirmation.
test: Complete the copy-and-compare steps without opening the JSON manually or missing a scope.

title: Large static customer metadata precedes every tool
evidence: src/pages/CustomerDetail.tsx:56–83: the six-field overview is always expanded above every tab. It becomes several rows on narrow viewports.
impact: Frequent users repeatedly scroll past address, website and service account to reach operational tools.
fix: Keep customer/domain/status visible and make secondary metadata collapsible, remembering the agent's preference.
test: On a 375px screen, reach directory and signature actions quickly while still being able to inspect full customer metadata.

title: Branding fields used by signatures have no editing flow
evidence: src/data.ts:298–313 derives company fields from Customer; customerLogo generates a mark. Customer has no logo field; src/store.tsx has no updateCustomer action.
impact: Agents can preview website/address/logo variables but cannot correct those customer values from this application.
fix: Provide a customer branding/details editor or identify the authoritative external source and its sync behavior.
test: Correct a company address and logo and verify every affected template preview reflects the intended source values.

title: Directory details cannot explain missing signature fields
evidence: src/components/UserTable.tsx: rows show name/email/title/department/org unit/status but no detail action for phone, mobile or location; these fields are used by signature variables.
impact: An agent who sees a missing-mobile warning cannot inspect the complete user record or identify how to correct it.
fix: Add a read-only user details panel and a clear source/update path for missing profile values.
test: From a missing-field warning, identify the affected record, view its relevant fields and understand how to fix them.

title: Templates can be saved despite being too long to assign
evidence: src/pages/flows/TemplateWizard.tsx:30–39 only validates name, description and nonempty content; the 10,000-character block is deferred to src/components/Preflight.tsx:45.
impact: Agents can save a template and proceed to recipients before discovering a known blocking issue.
fix: Validate the length at save and provide a draft status if retaining an invalid draft is intentional. Also check personalized output against the product's agreed size policy.
test: Save content above the configured limit and content that expands beyond it after variables resolve; show an actionable editor error.

title: Next silently commits template changes
evidence: src/pages/flows/TemplateWizard.tsx:41–60 calls saveTemplate before navigating to assignment; the button is labeled Next.
impact: An agent may expect a reversible next step and unintentionally update a reusable template even if assignment is later abandoned.
fix: Label the action Save and choose recipients, and state whether changes affect only future assignments or existing deployments.
test: Edit a template, advance, cancel assignment and verify the user understood whether the template was saved.

title: Wizard numbering does not explain entry points or total steps
evidence: src/components/FormLayout.tsx:3 renders only Step N; src/pages/flows/AssignWizard.tsx:133 starts direct assignment at Step 2.
impact: Users entering from Assign Signature appear to have skipped a step and cannot see the process ahead.
fix: Use named progress steps and correct totals for Create → Recipients → Review versus direct Recipients → Review.
test: Start assignment from both entry points and verify progress, Back, Exit and completed-step behavior.

title: Template identification will become ambiguous as the library grows
evidence: src/pages/tabs/SignaturesTab.tsx has no search or preview action; TemplateWizard accepts duplicate names and has no name-length limit.
impact: Long or duplicate names make the assignment select hard to use and increase the chance of choosing the wrong template.
fix: Define a name policy, add search when needed, and offer quick preview/assign from a template row with recognizable metadata.
test: Find and select the correct template among 50 entries including duplicates and very long names.

title: Raw signature HTML is injected without sanitization
evidence: src/components/SignatureEditor.tsx:115 writes html into innerHTML; link/image tools interpolate strings into HTML; src/components/SignaturePreview.tsx uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML; src/data.ts:318 replaces variables but does not sanitize markup.
impact: Pasted or authored HTML can introduce unsafe attributes, URLs or page-affecting markup into the application context. This is a confirmed unsafe sink; an exploit was not executed.
fix: Apply a documented allowlist sanitizer at input, save and rendering boundaries; safely construct link/image nodes and restrict URL protocols. Consider an isolated preview.
test: Use inert sanitizer fixtures for event attributes, disallowed protocols, style leakage and malformed markup, preserving approved email-signature formatting.

title: Editor popovers lack expected keyboard dismissal and focus behavior
evidence: src/components/SignatureEditor.tsx:528–640 uses custom popovers closed only by mousedown outside. In the preview, pressing Escape while Font was expanded left it expanded.
impact: Keyboard users cannot reliably dismiss, navigate or return focus from editor menus.
fix: Use the approved Radix-backed popover/menu primitives with Escape, focus return, appropriate roles and keyboard navigation.
test: Complete font/color/link/image operations by keyboard; Escape closes each overlay and restores a meaningful focus position.

title: Font and history controls do not communicate actual state
evidence: src/components/SignatureEditor.tsx:257 always displays Sans Serif; Undo/Redo are always enabled; command-state tracking covers toggles but not font/size or undo availability.
impact: The toolbar can imply a different font or available action from the current selection.
fix: Reflect selection font/size, handle mixed values and disable history controls when no action is available.
test: Select text with multiple fonts and sizes and verify toolbar state, Undo and Redo after both visual and HTML editing.

title: Link and image insertion lacks labeled validation
evidence: src/components/SignatureEditor.tsx:354–374,609–622: prompts rely on placeholders; image width is arbitrary text, images have no alt field and URL strings have no structured validation.
impact: Agents can insert broken images, unintended links or inaccessible content without guidance.
fix: Use visible labels, protocol-aware URL validation, positive width constraints, image alt text and useful inline errors/preview.
test: Try empty, malformed, variable-based, mailto/tel and image URLs, invalid widths and meaningful alternative text.

title: Missing variables can leave broken visual fragments
evidence: src/data.ts:318–324 replaces missing values with empty strings; default HTML includes separators and an image token. Preview and preflight warn but do not offer field fallbacks or conditional blocks.
impact: A signature can contain orphan separators, empty contact lines or a broken image when customer/user data is incomplete.
fix: Offer optional fallback values or conditional blocks, and make affected-user previews reachable from warnings.
test: Preview users missing mobile/title/location and customers without branding; ensure output remains intentional.

title: Typed notification addresses are lost unless explicitly committed
evidence: src/pages/flows/NotifyPicker.tsx: query is local state; only suggestion selection or Enter invokes add. TemplateWizard saves only notify, with no knowledge of pending query.
impact: An agent may type an address then save, expecting that address to receive notifications later, while it is silently omitted.
fix: Provide an explicit Add recipient action or commit valid pending input on save/blur; block saving on invalid uncommitted input.
test: Type a valid address then click Save without Enter, and verify it is committed or an explicit correction is required.

title: Selected notification chips can hide the actual address
evidence: src/pages/flows/NotifyPicker.tsx: selected chips display the directory label with the email only in title and the remove control's accessible name.
impact: Agents cannot easily distinguish similarly named recipients during review, especially on touch devices.
fix: Expose the address in chip detail or a focus/touch-accessible disclosure and make freeform-address support visible.
test: Select two people with the same display name and verify each destination without relying on mouse hover.

title: Scheduled assignment is selectable but cannot complete
evidence: src/pages/flows/AssignWizard.tsx:195 enables Scheduled and date inputs; line 152 disables final assignment for every scheduled execution. The initial helper only says a scheduler is required.
impact: Users spend time configuring a flow that has no success path.
fix: Disable/mark scheduling unavailable at the first decision, or implement schedule creation, management, editing and cancellation before enabling it.
test: No user can enter an apparently completable scheduling path that only reveals its blocking limitation at review.

title: CSV import does not gate progression in signature assignment
evidence: src/components/RecipientPicker.tsx:41–47 reads files asynchronously; src/pages/flows/AssignWizard.tsx:235 does not receive onImportingChange, so Review assignment remains enabled while reading.
impact: A user can advance with the previous recipient selection while an import is still processing; on unmount its result is discarded.
fix: Propagate import state to assignment, disable progression while reading and clearly announce when the imported selection becomes authoritative.
test: With a delayed file read, click Review immediately after upload and verify the final recipient set cannot be stale.

title: Selections outside the current filter need a visible management view
evidence: src/components/UserTable.tsx: selections persist independently of filtering; the assignment footer shows total selected, but there is no Show selected or global clear action in the signature picker.
impact: Users can forget hidden selections while narrowing to another department and include unintended recipients.
fix: Add Show selected, Clear selection and a visible hidden-selection count; retain the existing explicit all-matching/entire-directory labels.
test: Select users across departments and pages, apply another filter, then inspect and clear the complete selection.

title: Import exceptions cannot be fully inspected or corrected
evidence: src/components/RecipientPicker.tsx:171–196 shows counts plus only the first three unmatched/ineligible addresses; invalid records are counted without row details. A successful import immediately replaces the selection.
impact: Agents cannot identify all rejected rows or recover their previous selection after a mistaken replacement.
fix: Offer a full row-level import report and an apply/replace confirmation or undo that preserves the prior selection.
test: Import a mixed file with more than three errors; identify every rejected row and restore the prior selection.

title: Preflight image checks miss equivalent HTML forms
evidence: src/components/Preflight.tsx:33 matches only src="http:// with exact casing and double quotes; valid single-quoted, uppercase or spaced attributes are not inspected.
impact: The same problematic image can either trigger a warning or be missed depending on HTML formatting.
fix: Parse sanitized HTML and inspect normalized image sources and relevant output fields rather than using a narrow string match.
test: Equivalent image markup with double/single quotes, spacing and casing produces the same check result.

title: Batch progress and completion do not communicate enough state
evidence: src/components/BatchModal.tsx:109–137: the progress display is a styled div without progressbar semantics; completion always uses a green check regardless of failed count. Modal Close remains visible while its callback is a no-op during processing.
impact: Assistive technology misses progress, failures look successful at a glance, and a visible close button appears broken during work.
fix: Use an announced progress/status model, outcome-specific heading/icon and explicit busy-dismissal behavior with a reason.
test: Run all-success, partial-failure and all-failure fixtures and verify accurate announcements, outcome styling and close behavior.

title: Unexpected batch exceptions can leave a permanent running dialog
evidence: src/components/BatchModal.tsx:50–84 invokes job.run and commitBatch inside a timer without a failure handler; processing dialogs cannot close.
impact: An unexpected execution error has no visible failure or recovery route.
fix: Wrap execution/commit in explicit pending/success/failure states and retain a retry or safe-close path, preserving diagnostic context.
test: Inject a failing job and a failing commit and verify the dialog exits Running with actionable recovery.

title: New delegate records have no status
evidence: src/pages/tabs/DelegatesTab.tsx:86–93 creates entries without status; the table renders status ?? '—' at line 184, although Delegation supports active/pending.
impact: Newly added delegates are less informative than existing records, and agents cannot tell whether access is pending or active.
fix: Define the demo status and the connected lifecycle explicitly; set status on creation and show what Pending means.
test: Add a delegate fixture and verify a meaningful status, timestamp and history result are consistent.

title: Mailbox-owner selection does not scale and access has no customer-wide overview
evidence: src/pages/tabs/DelegatesTab.tsx:38,111–128: all owners are placed in a native select, and rows are shown only for the chosen owner.
impact: At large directory sizes, finding an owner or discovering mailboxes that currently have delegates becomes slow.
fix: Use a searchable owner picker and consider a customer-wide delegation view with owner/delegate search and filters.
test: Find an owner among 1,000 users and answer which mailboxes currently have delegated access.

title: Delegate picker exposes filters and labels that do not fit its eligible set
evidence: src/components/UserTable.tsx: status options always include suspended; DelegatesTab prefilters to active users. The dialog's header checkbox is announced Select entire directory even though only eligible delegates are present.
impact: A Suspended filter predictably returns nothing and select-all wording overstates the target population.
fix: Derive status options from eligible data or omit the redundant filter; parameterize selection wording to Select all eligible delegates.
test: Inspect every delegate filter and select-all label, including empty eligible sets and suspended owners.

title: Retry bypasses review and uses the current template
evidence: src/pages/tabs/HistoryTab.tsx:113–145 fetches the current template and immediately creates a batch for failed user IDs; it does not reuse signatureChecks or preserve original rendered content/version in LogEntry.
impact: A retry after a template edit can assign different content from the original batch, including content that current preflight would block.
fix: Store an immutable batch template snapshot/version, show retry scope/content, rerun preflight and link retry history to the parent run.
test: Fail a run, edit the template, then retry: verify explicit version choice, current checks and parent-child audit trace.

title: History dates omit year and timezone
evidence: src/data.ts:432–439 formats month/day/time only; CustomerDetail also splits that localized string on a comma. History offers no date-range filter.
impact: Old and recent activity can look identical across years, and distributed agents may interpret timestamps differently.
fix: Use explicit localized date formatting with year and timezone where relevant; format date-only values separately and add date-range filtering when history grows.
test: Compare records spanning years and two timezones; verify exports and UI describe the same instant.

title: Persisted sample history makes a real API-success claim
evidence: In the inspected preview, Brio Technologies → History → Company standard displayed Signature updated via Gmail API and Gmail API: 429 rate limit exceeded. Current execution is explicitly local demo. These messages may be legacy persisted data rather than current seed strings.
impact: Users can mistake historical demo rows for verified external actions.
fix: Label sample history at row/detail level and migrate legacy stored messages; keep demo/live provenance as explicit data.
test: Open both fresh and existing browser storage and verify no sample entry implies a real Gmail operation.

title: Recipient filters become unreadable on a 375px screen
evidence: At 375×812, assignment search remained wide while Department and Account status shrank to narrow arrow-only controls. src/components/UserTable.tsx combines a shrinking filter group with flex inputs and min-w-0 selects.
impact: Mobile users cannot see which filters are selected or confidently change recipient scope.
fix: Use a responsive grid or full-width filter rows with minimum readable widths; keep selected labels visible.
test: At 375px and 320px, with long selected labels and zoom, every filter value and action remains readable and operable.

title: Checkbox hit areas are only 18px
evidence: src/components/ui.tsx:218 uses size-4.5 for role=checkbox buttons. No larger control wrapper is provided; row clicks increase mouse coverage but do not consistently enlarge the checkbox's own target.
impact: Small selection controls are difficult for touch and motor-impaired users, particularly in dense tables.
fix: Keep the visible checkbox compact within a larger hit area, checking target spacing and row interaction for each table.
test: Measure effective targets and spacing in selection tables on touch viewports; verify keyboard toggling remains clear.

title: Shared Field couples label, hint and error text into accessible names
evidence: src/components/ui.tsx:115–152 wraps children, hint and error in a label without IDs/describedby. In the preview the template input name became Template name Enter a template name. and description included its character counter.
impact: Screen-reader field names change when errors appear, and helper content is not exposed as a stable separate description.
fix: Use explicit htmlFor/id and aria-describedby/aria-errormessage; focus the first invalid field after submission and mark required semantics consistently.
test: Submit invalid forms and inspect accessible name, description, required state and focus before and after correction.

title: Legacy visual and primitive patterns remain alongside Brio components
evidence: src/pages/Login.tsx uses a dark gradient panel; ui.tsx/SignatureEditor/HistoryTab retain slate/violet/emerald literals, off-grid gaps and custom controls. ui/input.tsx and ui.tsx expose parallel input implementations; complex editor overlays are custom rather than Radix-backed.
impact: Future fixes and visual changes can drift between screens despite the strong shared yellow/Inter foundation.
fix: Consolidate primitives incrementally and map remaining UI colors/spacing/motion to approved tokens, preserving signature-content formatting as its own concern.
test: Review sign-in, dialogs, tables and editor against the same control, token and keyboard behavior inventory; verify actual shadcn/Radix usage rather than assuming compliance.
